item.title: Version 1.6.10
item.changes: Larger drag area to allow easier dragging of layers and folders to first slot in layer panel Drag and drop a layer at the bottom of a folder: let go in the upper half of the gap under the folder's last layer to put it inside, or the lower half to put it outside The drop line indents to show which folder a layer will land in A dragged layer is see-through, so you can see the list under it A dragged layer stays full size as it leaves the Layers panel and comes back New Canvas remembers the last size you used
